science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Map the instability of the ferrofluid sea's magnetic shear.
horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Secure the perimeter against environmental breaches.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The churning expanse of the ferrofluid sea writhes under intense magnetic storms, forming jagged black spikes that crash against the basalt cliffs. Brilliant arcs of electrostatic discharge leap between the waves, illuminating the metallic shore in stark flashes of violet. High on an observation pinnacle, brass wind-chimes spin wildly in the erratic gales.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Glossy black ferrofluid peaks illuminated by violet electrostatic arcs
sensory_palette.sound: Deep rumbling crashes of fluid metal and the chaotic ringing of brass wind-chimes
sensory_palette.smell: Ozone from electrical discharge mixed with a sharp metallic tang
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: A biting cold wind laced with prickling static charge
sensory_palette.taste_optional: A faint, coppery taste on the back of the tongue

interactive_features.affordance_description: Can be adjusted to ground excess charge from the incoming storm.
A pool of fluid that can be manipulated with a magnetizer to pull useful metallic elements.
A jagged outcropping that offers shelter from the magnetic shear.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: Absorb kinetic and magnetic energy from the sea's shear.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Darting through the cresting spikes and clustering around energy discharges.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: They interfere with precise cartographic readings by scrambling local compass bearings.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: Will eventually aggregate into a massive, disruptive magnetic anomaly if left to feed.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: Kaio must chart the Kelvin-Helmholtz shear patterns to understand the sea's erratic behavior.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: Accurate maps are required to prevent the ferro-squids from disrupting the sanctuary's defensive grid.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: Mastering the magnetohydrodynamic forces is essential for turning the hostile wilds into a sustainable habitat.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: Misreading the shear will result in flawed map data, causing future navigation hazards.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Kaio's compass shatters, leading him to mark a completely inaccurate magnetic north.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: Kaio gets the readings but is heavily irradiated by static charge, requiring downtime.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: Kaio perfectly charts the shear patterns and identifies safe traversal routes.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Kaio not only charts the shear but discovers a hidden, stable current useful for rapid transit.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Kaio sprints back to the Hub, breathless, to hand off the brass-etched map to Ryn.
